CPNPluginConfig.name: Roundcube Webmail
CPNPluginConfig.description: Roundcube is an Email host package (not a site plugin). Install from Plugins > Host packages (Email), or run: cpn app install --name roundcube. Deploys under /opt/cpn-webmail/roundcube with panel proxy /roundcube/ (IMAP localhost:143). This Plugin Store card does not install files.
CPNPluginConfig.author: master3395
